issues.description: tools/lint_test_isolation.py src/lua/iss0624_lua_11_13_test.zig reports MAJOR T030 at line 915 — 'test allocates but has no defer cleanup'. The flag is a false positive: StructuredLogger.init(allocator) at src/lua/structured_logger.zig:90-94 is allocation-free (returns a struct literal with the allocator field only); the struct has no deinit method. The test binds the result to a `const` for @typeInfo inspection only. A defensive `defer logger.deinit()` was attempted during Step 4 but rejected because the method does not exist on the type (compile error at src/lua/iss0624_lua_11_13_test.zig:928:17). The mandated pre-handoff lint target `tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration` exits 0, so the MINOR does not block Step 4 PASS.

TC-ISS-0624-LUA-11-09 ('write nil to an existing key drops it') currently FAILS under zig build test — `try testing.expect(r.success)` at src/lua/iss0624_lua_11_13_test.zig:496 reports `r.success == false`. The test correctly validates design §6.2 TC-09 ('write of nil_value drops the key rather than storing a nil sentinel'); the failure signals a real production-code defect in src/lua/host_api/write_variable.zig where the write path raises a Lua error for nil instead of staging .nil_value and letting the apply path at src/lua/executor.zig:770-777 drop the key. NOT a test-design defect; the test correctly detects the issue. Resolution path: BACKEND-DEV (rework 2/3) examines extractValueInto's nil branch and write_variable's orelse-error-raise branch — per design, nil must stage and the apply path must drop, not raise. The test will pass once the production path is fixed.
